method_plan.selected_plan: Move evaluation freshness checking from a high-frequency work-abort trigger to a fail-closed acceptance-publication barrier. This preserves frozen semantics and current-authority acceptance while allowing checker-v2/precommitted controls to finish despite unrelated worker commits.
